usedFor: Creators plan posts in Postpone, where “Schedule Reddit Post” and “Schedule Bluesky Post” queue posts for later.

bestTemplate.name: “New Published Post” in Postpone, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each published post is logged in a doc, which gives you a running record of what went out.

watchOut: “Delete Post” in Postpone can delete a post permanently, so check the option before it runs.
